requirements.requirement: Remote ingress rejects unauthenticated MCP requests.
Device bridge rejects unauthenticated device registration.
A connected device is selected explicitly or by configured default.
Runtime execution capacity is configurable and qualification demonstrates at least 4 concurrent workstation-effect lanes per device.
Execution concurrency at or above the 4-lane qualification floor is demonstrated against a real WorkBridge-qualified DesktopCommander payload, not inferred from a queue unit test.
requirements.note: Windows CI runs eight concurrent real start_process calls through the exact pinned DesktopCommander payload under an 8-execution/64-upstream-context profile and requires at least four simultaneous effects to be observed.

requirements.requirement: Runtime upstream-context capacity is configurable and qualification configures at least 32 independently identified upstream work contexts; these are scheduler contexts, not model workers, and identity is distinct from effect authority.
An upstream work context must bind an explicit device before workstation effect dispatch.
Concurrent client JSON-RPC IDs cannot collide inside the workstation bridge.
Packaged Node and DesktopCommander entrypoint hashes are checked before process launch.
The WorkBridge manifest is authenticated against trusted provenance rather than trusted solely because it is local.
requirements.note: Device startup requires WORKBRIDGE_TRUSTED_MANIFEST_SHA256 and rejects malformed or mismatched SHA-256 trust anchors; exact-payload CI supplies the independently captured manifest digest.

requirements.requirement: Disconnect rejects in-flight requests and reconnect does not silently replay them.
Official MCP SDK initialize/tools-list round trip succeeds through remote ingress and device bridge; real WorkBridge-qualified payload execution is qualified separately.
Windows device-agent operation is exercised on CI or equivalent clean Windows runner.
requirements.note: Windows CI builds/tests the implementation, parses the launcher, builds the exact pinned DesktopCommander payload, launches the device bridge, verifies MCP initialize/tools-list, and executes concurrent real start_process calls through the bridge.

requirements.requirement: Production endpoint, OAuth/device pairing, deployment, and activation remain separate effect claims.
A stale device generation is rejected before dispatch, while timeout or disconnect after dispatch is classified OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and is never silently replayed.
